$ cage report --by agent
Ledger by agent

agent    calls     tok in  tok out  gross tok
-------  -----  ---------  -------  ---------
copilot      4  1,968,011   96,212    100,000
claude       2    912,400   61,200    160,000
kiro         2    699,122        0          0
TOTAL        8  3,579,533  157,412    311,340

· kiro: input-only log — tok out not recorded; its rows also carry no per-turn time, session or project (`cage query kiro-routing`)
· saved is GROSS — avoided read cost; it excludes the cost of USING the tool
  (the invoking turn, the injected context). `cage query gross-vs-net`
  net vs spend = gross − this window's spend, not net of the tools' cost of use.
· 2 calls unpriced — matters when you view $ (`--usd`; cage prices unpriced)
